notes.title: Bot Rush Update v1.0.0!
notes.content:
We finally made it to release! This is likely going to be the last major update unless we decide to come back and add more. We made our most requested new gamemode: "Bot Rush" along with many small bug fixes and QOL, we also added drill bullets as a new modifier. Here is the change log since v0.21.0!

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new gamemode Bot Rush
[*] Added fireworks to final scoreboard win screen
[*] Added modifier Drill Bullets
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where a dead players would appear at the center of the map if they die far away
[*] Fixed issue where bullets shot from a high spread gun would break all the bullets shot
[*] Fixed bug where when a player joins during a global shop you couldn't spectate them
[*] Fixed sand background turning into sand block when saving/loading maps in the level editor
[*] Fixed glitchy visuals for flags when at high fps
[*] Fixed movespeed to actually increase move speed rather than just acceleration
[*] Fixed Immortal visual not showing the correct visual on clients sometimes
[*] Fix shop scrolling to not get stuck
[*] Fixed bug where Shrinkify could get you stuck in walls
[/list]

[b]QOL[/b]
[list]
[*] Added visual effect when flags get close to each other in CTF
[*] Changed the CTF win condition to activate when both the flags get within 1 block
[*] Changed shop size to scale with screen size
[/list]

notes.title: Game Art Update Part 2 v0.21.0!
notes.content:
In this update I've finished creating the new art for the game as well as re-doing the old UI look. We've also refactored the bot shopping AI and combat. There have also been many QOL and bug fix changes. Here is the change log since v0.20.0!

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new visuals to all UI buttons, sliders, inputs, drop downs, and toggles
[*] Changed more of low-res textures to high-res
[*] Added a start of game text that tells you which gamemode it is and a rough idea on what to do in it
[*] Added hover visual when hovering modifiers in the shop
[*] Made bots able to purchase activatable abilities
[*] Made bots pre-fire around corners
[*] Improved bot shopping AI
[*] Added a tournament mode command which disables unwanted features, makes most things host authoritative and saves a game log after each game
[*] Added ghost hat
[*] Added final game end screen that shows the top three players/teams
[*] Made scoreboard confetti more colorful
[*] Created new visual for bubble shield
[/list]

[b]Modifiers[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new modifier Barrel Rifling
[*] Added new modifier Splitting Bullets
[*] Added new modifier Resurrect
[*] Removed modifier Reinforced Barrel
[*] Removed modifier Smoke Field
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where background tiles in Capture The Flag weren't darkened
[*] Fix bug where bottles and flags would fall through the floor
[*] Fixed bug where you could shoot during the 3 second round start immunity
[*] Fixed bug where some of the old maps would not be able to load
[*] Fixed bug where you could lock the classes in Bottle Collectors and Castle Siege
[*] Fixed flood fill bucket to work with the level editor layering
[*] Fixed issue where you could get stuck in a wall when using Shrinkify
[*] Fixed bug where kamikaze didn't do any damage
[*] Fixed glitchy camera movement when slow-mo effect is happening
[*] Fixed glitchy bullet visuals when slow-mo effect is happening
[*] Fixed issue when inside a disabled breakable you could escape the map bounds
[*] Fixed bug where slow-mo effect wouldn't go away when going back to lobby
[*] Fixed bug where bullets would break against teammates bullets
[*] Fixed bug where you could teleport into a wall
[*] Fixed memory leak with lethal blades
[*] Fixed bug where player effects would still be running on bots when going back to lobby
[*] Made the fire delay stat go out to more decimals because it would round to 0
[*] Fixed jump height inconsistency
[*] Fixed custom resolution being reset when going back to menu
[*] Fixed bug where health bars would disappear sometimes after using cloaking device
[*] Fixed a chat bug on the host when you sending money to bots
[*] Fixed bug where players on teams wouldn't sync on join
[*] Fixed bug where sometimes explosive bullets didn't explode.
[*] Fixed bug where workshop maps wouldn't be selected on lobby load
[*] Fixed bug where spectators couldn't see invisible players
[*] Fixed bug where Repluser would push teammates
[/list]

[b]QOL[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a hit sound indicator when shooting breakables
[*] Made bouncy tiles bouncy on the bottom
[*] Made maps update if you have already uploaded it instead of making a copy
[*] Made the delta of what stats are changed when you hover modifiers
[*] Added a stat for spread
[*] Made bullets be able to fire multiple in the same frame
[*] Made the team chat command a toggle
[*] Made bullets much less likely to hit yourself when shooting while falling
[*] Changed the UI layout for the game settings menu
[*] Made map viewer have a much better resolution
[*] Added a /op command
[*] Made you able to open the previous match scoreboard
[*] Made the modifiers you have list open when you hold shift while hovering
[*] Made running the add bots command without arguments spawn 1 bot
[*] Made breakables go transparent if you shoot on your side in Capture The Flag
[*] Improved precision visual when using splitting bullets
[/list]

[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Change Bonus Shield to convert a percent of your health to shield
[*] Made Flamey Bullets levels infinite
[*] Balanced Spray
[*] Balanced Shotgun
[*] Balanced Armored Bullets
[*] Balanced Impact Cooled Armor
[*] Balanced Stinky
[*] Balanced Repulser
[*] Balanced turret
[/list]

[b]Performance[/b]
[list]
[*] Vastly improved the map load speed
[*] Improved performance when bullets hit breakables
[/list]

notes.title: Game Art Update Part 1 v0.20.0!
notes.content:
We've redone most of the art in the game to get rid of the repeating grid pattern! We have also reworked player and bullet collision as to not eat as much performance. There have also been some balance changes and there is now a slow-mo effect when you kill the last player! Here is the change log since v0.19.0!

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Remade most of the tile visuals for the game
[*] Background tiles are now able to place behind foreground transparent tiles
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where pings would not expire fast on clients
[*] Fixed bug where text size wasn't uniform over all the modifiers
[/list]

[b]QOL[/b]
[list]
[*] Made spectators not show up in the scoreboard
[*] Made host only chat commands only show if you are the host
[*] Added a slow-mo win effect to know if you just killed the last player
[/list]

[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed Adrenaline Rush to only give 10% move speed and made it cost 7
[*] Changed Heavy Bullet's cost to 3
[*] Changed Heavy Bullets and No-Grav Bullets to max at 3
[/list]

[b]Performance[/b]
[list]
[*] Completely reworked player and bullet collision
[/list]

[*] Fixed bug where text size wasn't uniform over all the modifiers

notes.title: Bots Update v0.19.0!
notes.content:
In this update we have added bots! There is also now a modifier selector panel in the host's settings where the host can enable and disable annoying modifiers. Bots aren't quite intelligent enough to play on some of the complex gamemodes yet, so that might come in a later update. You should also experience much better performance with large amounts of players or bots, and bullets are next up for optimization. We have also added a command for players to enter spectator mode if you would like to observe rather than play. Here is the change log since v0.18.0!

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added bots
[*] Added lists in the settings menu that allow you to enable or disable certain modifiers
[*] Added a command to enter and leave spectate mode
[*] Added a W hat
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where you could hit players while they are unloaded
[*] Fixed Capture The Flag respawn time not being used correctly
[*] Fixed bug where bullets would pass right through players
[*] Fixed bug in Bottle Collectors where bottles could go into racks after the game ends
[*] Fixed bug in Bottle Collectors where switching classes while having Proximity Mines placed would change the amount of damage they deal
[*] Fixed bug where player physics weren't being disabled during shop and map load phases
[*] Fixed colors syncing from team colors to flag and background color while playing Capture The Flag
[*] Fixed shop closing if a player leaves during map load
[*] Fixed bug where sounds would sometimes not play
[/list]

[b]QOL[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a way to select modifiers that are more new player friendly
[*] Allowed spectators to free cam around
[*] Made loading screens flow better
[*] Added bullet movement prediction
[/list]

[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed Smoke Field radius and duration
[*] Balanced Sumo Damage
[*] Balanced Flamey Bullets
[*] Balanced Goliath
[*] Balanced Proximity Mines
[*] Balanced lethal blades to scale off damage rather than max health
[*] Balanced repulser to have more range and less cost
[/list]

[b]Performance[/b]
[list]
[*] Heavily increased performance when having large amounts of players and bots
[*] Made breakable tile effects cost way less performance
[*] Condensed audio sources into a main global audio player
[*] Added recycling of bullets objects
[*] Fix performance for player UI
[*] Increased performance for getting players in a rectangle
[/list]

notes.title: Bottle Collectors Update v0.18.0!
notes.content:
It's been a long wait, but Bottle Collectors is finally here! We have also made some changes to the range of teleport, along with that, there are quite a few other small bug fixes and QOL changes. Here is the change log since v0.17.0!

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new gamemode Bottle Collectors
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where if a player leaves you will get things in your shop that you already have max of
[*] Fixed extend points command to extend time in Castle Siege and Bottle Collectors
[*] Fixed bug where sometimes players will randomly explode while respawning
[*] Fixed bug where players can die in the shop while playing Juggernaut
[*] Fixed bug where Random would give modifiers that put you over maximum
[/list]

[b]QOL[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed the "invalid arguments" prompt to be more useful when typing commands
[*] Changed Capture The Flag's respawn time go up over time so that the game doesn't last forever

[*] Changed shooting and picking up flags have less of a delay between actions
[*] Made your old ping disappear if you try to ping a new one
[/list]

[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed Flamey Bullets damage scaling to be better
[*] Changed Teleport to have a radius of how far you can teleport
[/list]

notes.title: Improved Shop Update v0.17.0!
notes.content:
There have been a bunch of new changes in this update! First of all there are 5 new modifiers, a couple tweaks to the scoreboard, some changes to how teams work, and most of all the shop has been reworked to allow for locking in modifiers so it will appear next round! There has also been a few extra minor changes as well and quite a few bug fixes. Here is the change log since v0.16.17!

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the ability to lock modifiers in the shop so you can buy it next round
[*] Added new modifier Smoke Field
[*] Added new modifier Lethal blades
[*] Added new modifier Stinky
[*] Added new modifier Anti-Grav Bullets
[*] Added new modifier Heavy Bullets
[*] Added a command to extend the points to win mid game
[*] Added ability to change team's names and colors
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed conversion rate from crit chance to damage
[*] Fixed scoreboard would disappear when you go back to lobby
[*] Fixed bug where you could leave and rejoin to cycle your shop
[*] Fixed commands to not be case-sensitive
[*] Fixed chat to not get in the way of clicking modifiers
[*] Fixed issue where donation limit would not reset on back to lobby
[*] Fixed issue where you could get double money when joining at a specific time
[*] Fixed bug where chat commands couldn't be cycled through
[/list]

[b]QOL[/b]
[list]
[*] Made teams only appear as one scoreboard entry
[*] Changed the win screen to show for much longer so it is more obvious who won
[*] Added a lock icon on the maps and general tabs if you are a client
[*] Made maps sorted by spawn count to show size
[*] Made teams get deleted/regenerated when switching gamemodes
[/list]

notes.title: Refundable Modifiers Update v0.13.0!
notes.content:
We've added one of the most requested features of being able to remove/refund a modifier after being purchased! As always there are a bunch of QOL improvements and other changes since v0.12.0!

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the ability to remove purchased modifiers in the same shop you purchased them in
[*] Added Extended Barrel modifier
[*] Added icons for Castle Siege classes
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Heat Per Shot was displayed wrongly in the modifier shop stat display
[*] Fixed Sumo Damage was calculated wrongly in the modifier shop stat display
[*] Fixed explosive radius to be larger depending on bullet size
[*] Fixed bullet spawning to be depending on where your camera is not your body
[*] Fixed move color selector over to the right a little bit to avoid UI intersection
[*] Fixed map save issue while holding the border selection tool
[*] Fixed stalemate if a player leaves with one player left
[*] Fixed issue when joining through steam from the level editor
[*] Fixed rejoining in Castle Siege will recreate all the breakable blocks
[*] Fixed you can no longer join a server that you are already in
[*] Fixed points would carry over from in the lobby and not get reset on round start
[*] Fixed zone would visually close to nothing but would still have a small safe part where it closed to
[/list]

[b]QOL[/b]
[list]
[*] Made Heat Per Shot flash when you are over your max heat
[*] Added info about heat to the Shotgun modifier
[*] Change ban system to ban you from steam lobby
[*] Added support to purchasing modifiers while on controller
[*] Added support to navigating main menu while on controller
[/list]

[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 1 heat per shot to sumo and some extra health
[*] Change Spray's damage negative to -10%
[*] Change Shotgun's damage negative to -10%
[/list]

[b]Performance[/b]
[list]
[*] Added network player movement update batching to save network RPC header size
[*] Removed unnecessary recreation of the modifiers list when someone joins
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.12.0!
notes.content:
There has been a bunch of QOL improvements and changes Since v0.11.0!

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Grave Yard hat
[*] Added Taco hat
[*] Added Eyes hat
[*] Added Snowman hat
[*] Added Fruit Bowl hat
[*] Added Confusion hat
[*] Added Speech Bubble hat
[*] Added Duck hat
[*] Added Balloon hat
[*] Added Pickle Jar hat
[*] Added Alien hat
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed players were not being spawned properly in Castle Siege
[*] Fixed issue where you were able to pick up the flag as the death event happens
[*] Fixed bug where forcing back to lobby during map load you would get stuck in the map load screen
[*] Fixed scoreboard would get stuck open on back to lobby when its open
[*] Fixed bug with Swapper Bullets where it would make you go invisible
[*] Fixed spectating would get stuck on dead bodies
[*] Fixed color selector UI scaling
[*] Fixed UI scaling for the players done shopping text
[*] Fixed you could see players in map viewer
[/list]

[b]QOL[/b]
[list]
[*] You can no longer spectate enemies unless all your teammates died in Battle Royale
[*] Changed game font from LiberationSans to NovaSquare
[*] Added a waiting panel for other players to finish loading the map to give slow PCs more time
[*] Changed King Of The Hill scoring to be always give points if standing in the circle
[*] Removed bounty hunter from King Of The Hill
[*] Made next juggernaut get weighted to be more likely depending on how much damage you dealt
[*] Breakable blocks no longer have a delay when breaking for clients
[*] Changed breakable tiles to be an amount of hits it can take instead of a health value
[/list]

[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed Shield Shredders bonus shield damage to 20%.
[*] Changed Shield Steals lifesteal percent to 33.3%
[*] Changed Removed Unnecessary Weight to have negative health and shield multipliers
[*] Changed Glass Cannon to have negative health and shield multipliers
[*] Changed Combo Master max level to 5 and shielding to 20%
[*] Changed Flamey Damage to cost 7 and be 20% of your damage (doesn't change with level)
[*] Changed Living Bullets to be your heat per shot squared
[*] Changed Shotgun to have a heat multiplier
[*] Changed Armored Bullets to have less fire delay
[*] Changed Fast Bullets to give less velocity
[/list]

[b]Performance[/b]
[list]
[*] Jumping would use a bunch of network
[*] Bullets only spawn near the player
[*] Fixed performance with Swapper Bullets
[*] Made rule tiles only connect to itself
[/list]

notes.title: Level Editor Update v0.11.0!
notes.content:
You can now easily create levels with the new changes done to the level editor! As always there are a bunch of QOL improvements and changes Since v0.10.0!

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added level editor gamemode specific elements
[*] Added Ctrl+Z to undo changes in the Level Editor
[*] Added tried to buy modifier sound
[*] Added bought modifier Sound
[*] Added a top 3 damaging players in juggernaut scoreboard
[*] Added Q to quick pick block of type under your mouse
[*] Added a limit to the boarder size
[*] Added error display for when you have wrong amount of spawns
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed kill feed UI was covering other UI
[*] Fixed spectating would get stuck on dead bodies
[*] Forgot to add shopping time game setting for Capture The Flag
[*] Fixed Capture The Flag doesn't sync team points on join
[*] Fixed hat selector UI at weird resolutions
[*] Fixed scoreboard could be seen while closed at weird resolutions
[*] Fixed issue with player names display setting when disabling them
[*] Fixed camera movement look distance to clamp at a certain distance
[*] Fixed bug on controller where your barrel would not stay at the point of which you let go at
[*] Fixed bug where enemies name colors would turn friendly when toggling the player name display setting
[/list]

[b]QOL[/b]
[list]
[*] Added effects when capturing a flag
[*] Added a small immunity after respawn
[*] Added a increase/decrease money display when you get or lose money
[*] Your lobbies can now have custom names
[*] Level editor bucket fill no longer ignores map boarder
[*] Added a chat message that shames players who haven't finished shopping yet
[/list]

[b]Performance[/b]
[list]
[*] Map load speed now changes depending on player count
[*] Maps now save compressed
[*] Player movement updates don't get sent anymore while map loading
[*] Level editor box fill highlight does not lag as much anymore
[/list]

notes.title: Capture The Flag Update v0.10.0!
notes.content:
You can now play Capture The Flag with your friends! Along with that there are many new QOL improvements Since v0.9.34!

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new Gamemode Capture The Flag!
[*] Completely changed and reworked the network connection system
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed UI scaling with ultra wide screen resolution in modifier shop and scoreboard menus
[*] Fixed you can no longer join a lobby with the wrong version
[*] Fixed tooltip for gamemode info won't disappear anymore

[*] Added error display of what happened when you disconnected
[*] Added stat for fire delay
[*] Added info hovers to stats
[*] Added a button to join from a copied code from your clipboard
[*] Added a reset game settings back to default settings in host game settings menu
[*] Added save data for if lobby is public and max players in lobby settings
[*] Added an option to turn off player names
[*] Added an option to turn off chat
[/list]

[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Zone now does more damage
[/list]

[b]Performance[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed non moving dead player's bodies were taking network performance
[*] Fixed movement was updating during global shop
[/list]
